opening.argument: The presentation ties OneCoin participation to a speculative portfolio increase and a recruitment-based bonus structure. It says, “The split program can double your tokens portfolio” and that active participants can increase portfolio value “in just under ten weeks.” It also promises bonuses for “building your own Sales team,” while directing viewers to “register today” during a launch phase with limited positions and to complete registration forms. The offer further connects education packages and tokens to exchange trading and potential profit. Taken together, these are strong inducements to join and recruit. But the presentation does not establish the registration requirements, fees, token value, or whether the claimed portfolio increase or bonuses occurred.
